known.line: user: What colour is the attached image? Don't run commands. [swatch.png image/png]
known.reason: Devin 3000.10.23 replays a prompt's image as its bytes and type alone, with no name or path, so it can only be called an image. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store names Devin's own copy of it.

Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store names Devin's own copy of it.

Devin 3000.10.23 replays a finished call on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the result it sent live. A question's picks and a quiet command's exit come back from the update's `_meta` (`DEVIN_ACP_HOOKS.restated`); nothing in a read's update says how many lines it showed. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the result.
